**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
D2 PR2 revert-resolution predicate: redesign after judgment-round-1 NOT-APPROVED, then judgment-day (3 rounds) + ship as PR against feature/v2.0.0.

## Instructions (owner rulings this session)
- Path-scoped predicate dead; redesign to fail-closed content predicate. Judge candidates on "which direction does it fail?".
- Forge every attack (F-1..F-4, hostile-env), never reason. Every §7.1 row needs a fixture + mutation bar on merge topology.
- Fork A: REMOVE hardenDiffRendering (pure-read predicate). Fork B: keep config pins but tell the truth (forge the hostile env — the B6 harness).
- "The lie is the problem, not the pin" — false verification claims are the defect class to eliminate.
- Forge evidence must live in the repo. PR against feature/v2.0.0 with checks run.
- §7.1 mutation-bar claims must be EXECUTABLE (the cold-clone review runs them, doesn't read them).

## Accomplished
- Mechanism: normDiff = `git -c diff.algorithm=myers -c diff.renames=false -c core.attributesFile=/dev/null diff --no-textconv --no-ext-diff --no-renames --binary -U3`, drop /^@@ / /^index /, byte-exact rest. resolved(O,tip) ⟺ ∃ first-parent merge R: normDiff(R,R^1)==normDiff(O^1,O). Pure-read.
- resolution.mjs + .test.mjs rewritten (29 tests). design.md §3.0-3.6/§7.1 (A1-A6 + T1-T13). tasks.md PR3.
- Judgment-day 3 rounds: R1 (5 confirmed → forks), R2 (security resolved, 3 doc-honesty warnings → fixed), R3 (all resolved; 1 residual T1 singular over-claim → fixed). No fail-open survived.
- Committed 3 work-units (no AI attribution). Forge evidence in openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/forge/.
- PR #277 opened → feature/v2.0.0. 7/8 checks green (diff-size 207<400 PASS).

## Discoveries
- patch-id ignores indentation whitespace (killed it). --binary bypasses textconv but NOT diff.external → --no-ext-diff is load-bearing (both R2 judges forged; I under-tested it). hardenDiffRendering wrote --absolute-git-dir but git reads --git-common-dir → inert in worktrees. brain merges with --merge so offender/reverter are merge commits (git show combined = empty → first-parent mandatory). J-2: squash/direct-push reverts fall to human gate. blast radius = 3 lines (U3).
- STALE LOCAL feature/v2.0.0 (3174492) — origin/feature/v2.0.0 is 31f756d and ALREADY contains PR1 cursor. My branch adds ONLY the resolution redesign. Created+deleted a stray d2-pr1-cursor branch by mistake.
- actor-check FAILS: issue #259 status:approved self-applied by csrinaldi 2026-07-13 (pre-existing self-approval; owner's policy call; override:* label or non-author approval resolves it).

## Next Steps
- Owner: cold-clone external review (execute §7.1 claims), resolve actor-check (override or non-author approval), then merge → PR3.
- PR3 (brain-audit wiring) does not start until PR2 closes. brain/scratch/ left untracked (stray test artifact, not committed).

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs + .test.mjs — the predicate + 29 tests
- openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/design.md §3/§7.1, tasks.md PR3, forge/ (evidence + README)
- ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/d2-pr2-revert-resolution-redesign.md — full decision record
- PR #277 https://github.com/csrinaldi/brain/pull/277
